milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The player must navigate near the mossy stone brick structure (centered at spawn-relative ~4, 1, 4) and face it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has for cobblestone because stone blocks drop cobblestone when mined (not stone itself, unless Silk Touch is used). The player mines stone blocks placed at ~3-5, 0-1, 7-8 and receives cobblestone in their inventory. This is the standard 'mine' task verification — the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a golden pickaxe places it directly into the player's inventory. The player uses 3 gold ingots and 2 sticks from the chest with the crafting table to produce a golden pickaxe. The item was not in the starting inventory, so its presence confirms successful crafting.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind='block' because packed ice drops NOTHING when mined without Silk Touch — it simply disappears. Therefore inventory_has cannot be used. Instead, we verify that at least one packed ice block has been removed from the formation (originally 27 blocks in a 3x3x3 area at ~14-16, 0-2, 3-5). A generous box (±2 around the formation) checks that the packed ice count is at most 26, confirming at least one block was mined/broken.
